notes.title: v1.9 / v1.9f - Buffed
notes.content:
Strikes are changes from v1.9 to v1.9f

• Armor upgrade when leveling up
The tank will now get some armor upgrade (+66%) when leveling up. Basic and missile form will get a +20%. From MK-II onwards.

• Increased missile damage when leveling up 
Was +33% at each new level up. Now it is at [strike]+50%[/strike] +66%. From MK-II onwards.

• Scores are now a bit more readable
With digits.

• Ship leveling capped at [strike]MK-X[/strike] MK-V
[strike]Very few will reach this upgrade level.[/strike]
That way transformation loop is more fun and accessible. Plus you get more chances to use the laser tank!

• Smoother wave / carrier curve at the endgame
Carrier waves are now like this: 1 - 1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - 5 - 6 - 7. Was: 1 - 1 - 2 - 3 - 5 - 7.

• Added fire toggle option
Menu > Controls > Firemode.

That's it!

notes.title: v1.8 - Giulius
notes.content:
• Added more waves and carriers to the endgame
This applies only to the very best players out there.

• Added 'FPS Cap' option
A better version of the previous 'VSync' option that will let you manually set the fps cap up to your desktop refresh rate, if you desire.

• Added 'Song' option
Brought back the original song, which is called 'Giulius'.

[previewyoutube=3nnSsLz_aKg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

That's it!

notes.title: v1.7 - Safer
notes.content:
• Made the code a bit safer from cheating
Long overdue.

• You can mix gamepad input with mouse and keyboard
For example you can use one stick for movement and the mouse for shooting.

That's it!

notes.title: Version 1.6 - Updated
notes.content:
Unity engine updated to a more recent version.
Better screen options, now you can play fullscreen at 480p if you want to.
Leaderboards are not clipping names anymore.
Last day ranking is now available whenever you want. Go to Menu > Last Day (although wait the current day to end to see this change).


I've put v1.52 in the beta branch in case there are any game breaking issues, please let me know if that happens.

notes.title: Version 1.3 - Lazers!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27903609/aad8e8c7521a4c6ab52330ae5a12906e8eb5cad0.jpg

This is the biggest update yet and I believe it addresses a lot of the feedback I've got about the game in the past months in a way that is practical and fits with the game design.

I wont change the base gameplay anymore except for balancing tweaks. But I'd like to add some more enemies, we'll see.

Changes

Laser upgrade.
Each ship upgrade uses a different weapon.
The turret turns slower if you thrust. More noticeable on the Tank/Laser upgrade.
After each upgrade cycle the ship levels up.
Each ship level up does more damage but its also harder to get.
Ship level is shown on the scoreboard.
Several tweaks to the difficulty (I might need few more updates to get it right).
UI signalling for mines.
Option to disable the gamepad cursor.

notes.title: Testing twin-stick controls
notes.content:
Hello,
I've just uploaded a beta to test twin-stick controls, you can find it under 1_1_beta in the game betas panel.

I'm having more fun with the gamepad now (although I still prefer mouse only controls) but I need some feedback from you as I'm not sure how to proceed yet. Please give it a try.

A quick rundown:

Movement and firing directions are independent for all ship stages.
If you are not using a 360 controller you'll probably want to rebind the stick axes. Go to menu > controls.
You can play with mouse + wasd now.
You can still play with mouse only.
Single stick gamepad controls is still supported by using the fire button instead of the right stick.


Thank you.
